title: Task F1680 Integration-Point Damage Aggregation and Mesh Topology Audit

provenance_reconciliation.arithmetic_identity: 2117 quads * 4 IPs + 52 tris * 1 IP = 8520 IP records

intracell_damage_variation.explanation: The coupled phase-field formulation computes the phase-field scalar d in UEL and transmits it to the companion UMAT via Fortran COMMON block /PHASE_SHARED/ D_COMM. The UMAT assigns STATEV(1) = D_COMM at all integration points of the companion element. Consequently, all 4 integration points of every CPE4 quad receive the identical scalar value d. The intracell variance across IPs is exactly zero (0.000000).

overshoot_quantification.assessment: Minor penalty/Newton tolerance artifact (< +0.06%), strictly confined to 8 elements in the crack wake; zero effect on crack topology or structural load capacity.

scientific_conclusion: The 8,520 records reported in Task F1678 represent integration-point records from 2,117 quadrilateral elements (CPE4, 4 IPs each = 8,468 records) and 52 triangular elements (CPE3, 1 IP each = 52 records), totaling exactly 2,169 unique physical damaged elements. Because the companion UMAT receives the phase field d as an element-level scalar from UEL via COMMON block /PHASE_SHARED/, all integration points within each element evaluate to the identical scalar value d. Hence, Max-IP, Last-IP, Mean-IP, and Min-IP aggregation rules are mathematically and numerically identical.
